home.eyebrow: Guidance that sees the whole person
home.title: A calmer, clearer path to managing your weight.
home.intro: WeightPilot brings evidence-informed information, a personalised assessment and practical next steps together in one private, reassuring place.
home.trust: Private by design · Evidence-informed · Built around you
home.photoAlt: Two adults having a supportive conversation in a bright, comfortable room.
home.photoCaption: Personalised guidance is most useful when your goals, health and everyday life are considered together.
home.supportBody: A considered experience that keeps information clear and your next steps easy to find.
home.approachBody: Weight-management guidance should feel personal, understandable and practical. WeightPilot is designed to make each step easier to navigate.
home.step1Body: Share your goals and health context through a structured questionnaire.
home.step2Body: Receive a clear, personalised guidance report with practical information about possible next steps.
home.step3Body: Keep your assessment, guidance report and private messages organised in one place.
home.optionsIntro: Healthy, lasting change rarely comes from one action alone. Knowing the main approaches can make the next conversation feel clearer.
home.option1Body: Weight can change when the energy your body uses and the energy you take in are out of balance. Food, activity and sustainable habits matter, while sleep, medicines, health conditions and biology can also influence progress.
home.option2Body: Support may include nutrition, physical activity and behaviour change. For some adults, prescribed medicines or specialist surgery may also be considered alongside ongoing lifestyle support and clinical review.
home.option3Body: The right approach depends on your health, medicines, goals, preferences and personal circumstances. A qualified clinician can help weigh the potential benefits, limitations and risks.
home.optionsNote: General information only — it does not replace personalised medical advice.
home.optionsCtaTitle: A more personal place to begin
home.optionsCtaBody: Explore guidance that considers your goals, health and everyday circumstances.
home.finalTitle: Ready to take the next step?
home.finalBody: Explore your options with guidance tailored to your circumstances.
home.finalInvitation: Personalised assessments and guidance reports are available by invitation.

questionnaire.title: A few details to guide your next steps
questionnaire.intro: This friendly questionnaire takes about two minutes. Your answers save automatically, so you can return whenever you need to.

about.title: About you
about.body: Start with a few basic details. Use your most recent measurements where possible.

goal.title: Your goal
goal.body: Tell us the weight you would like to work towards. This is for information and does not determine whether any option is right for you.
goal.hint: Your target should be lower than your current weight and can be corrected before submission.

health.title: Your health
health.body: Select everything that applies. This context helps make general information more relevant to your circumstances.
health.exclusiveHint: Choosing “None of the above” or “Not sure” clears other selections.

medication.title: Your medication
medication.body: If you take medicines, list their names and any details you think are useful. You can leave this blank.
medication.label: Current medicines (optional)
medication.placeholder: For example, medicine names and doses
medication.none: I do not currently take any medication

review.title: Review your answers
review.body: Check that everything looks right. You can correct any section before submitting.
review.guidanceBody: These answers and calculations support personalised information and administrator review. They are not a medical diagnosis, prescription or confirmation that a medicine or other option is suitable for you.

questionnaire.privacyNote: Your answers remain private. Completing the questionnaire does not request administrator review; you can choose that separately on the results page.

submitted.title: Preparing your overview
submitted.body: Your answers are now read-only. You can choose whether to request administrator review after reading your result.

analysis.title: Preparing your overview
analysis.body: This uses your saved questionnaire answers and a fixed set of safety-first rules.
analysis.label: Assessment progress

result.reviewTitle: A closer review is the safest next step
result.tirzepatideReason: Your calculated BMI is {bmi} and your stated target is a {loss}% reduction. In adults with obesity without type 2 diabetes, SURMOUNT-5 found greater average weight reduction with tirzepatide than semaglutide under the trial’s specific conditions.
result.discussCaution: This is a research-based discussion point, not a recommendation. Your answers do not prove safety or suitability, and trial averages cannot predict your result.
result.disclaimer: WeightPilot provides educational guidance only. A qualified prescriber must review complete health information, medicines, risks and preferences before any treatment decision.

reasons.HEALTH_CONDITION_SELECTED: You selected at least one health condition, so your circumstances need individual review before a medicine is named.
reasons.CURRENT_MEDICATION: You reported current medication, which needs to be checked for relevant interactions and monitoring considerations.
reasons.HEALTH_STATUS_UNCERTAIN: You indicated that some health information is uncertain. It should be clarified before discussing a specific medicine.
reasons.MEDICATION_STATUS_UNCLEAR: Your medication status is not clear enough to name a specific option safely.
reasons.INCOMPLETE_OR_INCONSISTENT: At least one required answer is missing or inconsistent and should be clarified first.
reasons.NO_DEFENSIBLE_DISTINCTION: Your answers do not provide a sound evidence-based reason to single out one medicine. A personalised review can consider the missing context.

considerations.title: Relevant health considerations
considerations.body: These notes highlight topics to discuss during an individual assessment. They are not conclusions about safety or suitability.
considerations.noneBody: That does not confirm either option is suitable. A questionnaire cannot capture every relevant detail, and complete health and medication information still matters.
considerations.missingInformation: WeightPilot does not treat an unanswered or unselected item as evidence that a risk is absent.

DIABETES.title: Diabetes
DIABETES.body: Diabetes type, glucose control and current medicines matter. Combining these medicines with insulin or some other diabetes medicines can increase the risk of low blood glucose.

CARDIOVASCULAR.title: Blood pressure or heart history
CARDIOVASCULAR.body: Your cardiovascular history should be considered as a whole. SELECT provides relevant semaglutide evidence for a defined group, but it is not a suitability decision for an individual.

KIDNEY_OR_LIVER.title: Kidney or liver health
KIDNEY_OR_LIVER.body: Kidney or liver conditions need individual review. Vomiting or diarrhoea can cause dehydration, which can be especially important when kidney function is affected.

PANCREATITIS_OR_GALLBLADDER.title: Pancreas or gallbladder history
PANCREATITIS_OR_GALLBLADDER.body: Pancreatitis and gallbladder history are important safety considerations. Current UK safety information warns about acute pancreatitis with this medicine class.

SERIOUS_DIGESTIVE.title: Serious digestive problems
SERIOUS_DIGESTIVE.body: Both medicines affect the digestive system and can delay stomach emptying. Existing serious digestive symptoms or conditions require careful individual assessment.

DIABETIC_EYE.title: Diabetic eye disease
DIABETIC_EYE.body: Diabetic eye disease and changes in glucose control can affect monitoring needs, particularly with semaglutide. This should be reviewed before any treatment decision.

PREGNANCY.title: Pregnancy, breastfeeding or pregnancy plans
PREGNANCY.body: GLP-1 medicines should not be used during pregnancy, while trying to become pregnant or while breastfeeding. Timing and contraception questions need professional advice.

OTHER_CONDITIONS.title: Other health conditions
OTHER_CONDITIONS.body: The questionnaire cannot safely interpret an unspecified condition. Its relevance needs to be assessed using fuller information.

UNCERTAIN_HEALTH_INFORMATION.title: Uncertain health information
UNCERTAIN_HEALTH_INFORMATION.body: Because you selected that you were not sure, no safety conclusion should be drawn until your health history has been clarified.

CURRENT_MEDICATION.title: Current medication
CURRENT_MEDICATION.body: Your listed medicines may affect suitability, monitoring or side-effect risk. The information should be checked for interactions and relevant combinations.

MEDICATION_INFORMATION_INCOMPLETE.title: Medication information not confirmed
MEDICATION_INFORMATION_INCOMPLETE.body: No medicine list or confirmation of no medication was provided. Suitability cannot be assessed safely without clarifying this information.
